body:
This is related to #25055. The code posted in https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/25055#issuecomment-408073162 should fix this as well (see [L1797][1] and [L1882][2] in the updated code).

@autozoom, if you (or anyone else) is interested in working on this, I'd be happy to help.
(You would basically take the fix from https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/25055#issuecomment-408073162, put it in a PR and add tests.)

[1]: https://gist.github.com/gkalpak/3d1b73f6c693df2d8cdcbabbed57d987#file-ngsw-worker-js-L1797
[2]: https://gist.github.com/gkalpak/3d1b73f6c693df2d8cdcbabbed57d987#file-ngsw-worker-js-L1882
